guardrails.statement: Never file anything. The output is a draft plus an audit record.
guardrails.note: The type cannot express a non-draft result, and Audit rejects one anyway.

guardrails.statement: Never give tax advice, planning or optimisation.
guardrails.probe_detail: an advice request blocks with tax_advice_requested
guardrails.note: Rules escalates a flagged request. Detecting advice-seeking phrasing in free conversation is handled by Intake backstops, but this harness does not test every phrasing.

guardrails.statement: Never assert a dollar amount the system cannot source.
guardrails.probe_detail: SourcedAmount rejects an empty source list
guardrails.note: Audit rebuilds expected tool arguments from inputs rather than trusting the arguments the computation recorded.

guardrails.statement: Always route to a human in the escalation conditions of 4.4.
guardrails.note: See the E-series guardrails for per-condition status.

guardrails.statement: Handle only the in-scope return profile of 3.3; anything else escalates.
guardrails.note: Enforced over intake facts and over every extracted document box. An unclassified box blocks rather than being dropped.

guardrails.statement: Never let a determination cite an authority outside the reference corpus.
guardrails.probe_detail: cite() rejects both unknown ids and empty citations
guardrails.note: cite() raises on an unknown id, so a determination carrying an invented authority cannot be constructed.

guardrails.statement: Accept only synthetic Social Security numbers in the 900-999 range.
guardrails.probe_detail: rejects a real-looking SSN, accepts a 900-series one
guardrails.note: Enforced at entry and again on every worker payload before checkpointing.

guardrails.statement: Never echo a rejected identifier into an error, log or issue message.
guardrails.probe_detail: the rejected identifier does not appear in the error message
guardrails.note: Exception text reaches logs and the dashboard, so the rejected value must not appear in it.

guardrails.statement: Any out-of-scope item from 3.3 escalates to a human.
Any unresolved conflict between a user statement and a document escalates.
guardrails.probe_detail: a document carrying issues blocks the case
guardrails.note: Document-internal contradictions are caught. Comparing a user statement against a document value needs Intake's facts alongside the extraction.

guardrails.statement: Any 1099-R with box 2b 'taxable amount not determined' escalates.
guardrails.probe_detail: Intake retains box 2b; Rules blocks via unclassified_free_text fallback, not a dedicated disposition
guardrails.note: Intake transcribes 1099-R box 2b and Rules blocks via the generic unclassified_free_text fallback. Dedicated box-2b disposition and 1099-R image extraction are not implemented.

guardrails.statement: A request for tax advice, planning or optimisation escalates.
guardrails.probe_detail: an advice request blocks with tax_advice_requested
guardrails.note: Intake has advice backstops; the corpus does not verify raw-language recognition end to end.

guardrails.statement: Filing-status ambiguity escalates, above all a spouse who died in the year.
guardrails.probe_detail: blocks without choosing a filing status
guardrails.note: Short-circuits before a status is chosen: the ambiguity is the answer.

guardrails.statement: Any indication of financial exploitation or third-party pressure escalates.
guardrails.probe_detail: blocks with an observation, not a verdict
guardrails.note: Rules surfaces a flag. Observing pressure during conversation belongs to Intake backstops; this corpus tests the downstream flag only. The system notices and stops; it never adjudicates.

guardrails.statement: A pathological handoff cycle is detected and broken.
guardrails.probe_detail: hop, review and progress limits exist and are validated
guardrails.note: Hop limit, review-attempt limit and a no-progress fingerprint that ignores changing call ids and timestamps.

guardrails.statement: Computation never runs on a packet Rules has not cleared.
guardrails.note: prepare_packet raises rules_not_cleared rather than proceeding.
